label: JSLinux (Linux in your browser)
what: A real Linux terminal that runs inside a web page, so you can try Bash commands without installing anything.

label: Microsoft Learn: Introduction to PowerShell
what: A free beginner lesson from Microsoft that explains PowerShell commands step by step.

label: SQLBolt
what: Short interactive lessons where you type database queries into the page and see the results at once.

label: pandas: Getting started
what: The official introduction to pandas, with short tutorials on working with tables of data in Python.

label: Learn Git Branching
what: A game-like lesson in your browser that teaches git commands by drawing what each one does.
